CatalogueMy orders

Order process · 6 October 2026

Confirm the details before paying.

Your inclusive quote

A catalogue request does not take payment. FI verifies the exact supplier variant, availability, receiving warehouse and delivery scope, then presents one inclusive AUD total. Confirm the product and delivery address before paying. Changes after approval require FI to review the quote again.

Warehouse inspection

The supplier delivers to the FI warehouse first. We check the agreed product, dimensions, finish, function and packaging before dispatching to you. Inspection reduces the risk of defects; it does not guarantee that every defect can be detected.

Payment and order records

When checkout is enabled, Stripe handles payment details. FI keeps payment references and status, your contact and delivery details, supplier purchase records, inspection results and shipment tracking. A payment redirect alone is not confirmation of payment.

Changes and problems

Contact fabricationintelligence@gmail.com about delivery changes, defects, cancellation or a return. FI will confirm the applicable arrangements before accepting a commercial order. These process notes do not limit applicable customer rights.
